checks.detail: QuestionSegmenter must look up QuestionRegionDetector.mlmodelc from the app bundle.

checks.name: Swift detector OCR merge fallback gate exists
checks.detail: Detector-first segmentation must only skip full-page OCR when OCR-matched detector boxes look complete, otherwise reuse first-pass detector boxes and merge unmatched OCR regions.

checks.name: Swift weak-layout text guard exists
checks.detail: ContentView observation dedupe must require compatible short text before weak layout keys can merge by geometry.

checks.name: Swift ranked candidate cap telemetry exists
checks.detail: Observation upload must rank candidates before the per-frame cap and report skipped-candidate risk telemetry.

checks.name: Swift dense section crop sender exists
checks.detail: Observation upload should add section/group rect-only crops for dense cap-risk, sparse weak/low-coverage, and empty study frames; dense sections keep top-2 anchors while risk sections keep a top-1 anchor.

checks.name: Swift empty-frame section dedupe exists
checks.detail: No-candidate page section crops must use separate section signatures so repeated empty-frame sections can be skipped without suppressing later per-question boxes.

checks.name: Swift Vision/JPEG resizing is pixel-bound
checks.detail: Vision analysis and upload JPEG compression must limit real CGImage pixels, not UIImage point size inflated by UIScreen scale.

checks.name: question crop source input_index binding exists
checks.detail: Batched crop extraction must preserve model-returned input_index and bind questions to the matching crop before falling back to text similarity.

checks.name: question crop candidate cap fallback is risk-aware
checks.detail: Backend fallback must keep old-client candidate-cap safety while using ranked-cap telemetry to avoid unnecessary full-frame VLM fallback.

checks.name: weak layout crop keys do not pre-dedupe extraction sources
checks.detail: Backend extraction source enumeration must not use weak layout question keys or their fingerprints to suppress crops before VLM extraction.

checks.name: section crop sources stay source-safe
checks.detail: Section crops may contain multiple questions, so backend manifest parsing, source dedupe, fallback policy, prompt text, and persisted extraction metadata must keep them as extraction sources rather than single-question identities.
